event_day_hydrologic_context.interpretation: Official event-day hydrologic context at Antapucro. It corroborates a high-flow state in the Lurin system on the positive-outcome date but does not by itself establish discharge, level, inundation depth or hydraulic capacity at Pachacamac/Cieneguilla/Lurin downstream reaches.

outcome_links.outcome_summary: Crecida del rio Lurin; 6 viviendas afectadas y 4 familias afectadas.
Crecida del rio Lurin sin afectados ni damnificados reportados en la zona.
outcome_links.reason_not_negative: Absence of reported damage does not demonstrate absence of hydrologic activation, inundation, bank erosion or threshold exceedance. Same-day river-state and rainfall evidence are still missing.

historical_alert_line_policy.policy: Historical chart alert lines are source-display context only and are excluded from IRFEN threshold derivation or operational promotion.
